content.title: Online interview?
content.subtitle: Some universities talk to students after shortlisting. Be ready.

steps.title: Camera and light
steps.detail: Your face should be clearly visible, with light from the front. Keep the background simple.
steps.tip: Do a test call with a friend the day before.

steps.title: Internet backup
steps.detail: Keep a phone hotspot ready along with Wi-Fi. Keep your laptop on charge.

steps.title: Research the university
steps.detail: Read about the course, faculty and projects. Be clear on why this one.

steps.title: Know your SOP
steps.detail: Say what your SOP says, in your own words. Don't memorise it.

steps.title: Have your questions
steps.detail: Write down a few good questions to ask at the end.
steps.tip: Asking questions shows you are serious.

caption:
Got an online interview? Prepare these 5 things in advance 👇

1. Camera and light
2. Internet backup
3. Research the university
4. Know your SOP
5. Have your questions ready

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend whose interview is coming up.
